resolution.note: red-CI proposals need a failing Check conclusion: gateTotals.failed run ids; two successes, cancelled-then-success, no conclusion give none; red-then-success gives one naming PR and run

title: brain CI-failure proposals require a red Check, not two green runs on one SHA
body:
Evidence 2026-11-18 (Astra gap map, .krn/runs/research/daily-2026-11-18/astra-full.md §2 item 5): gateTotals in src/outcome/ledger.ts counts reruns per commit; ciFailures in src/brain/evidence-proposals.ts reads a positive count as a failure, so two successful Check runs on one SHA yield a false 'run full local verification' proposal (reproduced: one proposal for PR 17). Distinct from t-sy4qhg1 (recheck after rebase).
Outcome: a red-CI proposal needs a failing conclusion and names the PR and run; two successes, a cancelled-then-success, or no conclusion give no failure evidence.
Proof: gateTotals([{check_runs:[success, success]}]) -> ciFailures([{number:17, prGate}]) deepEquals []; control with a real red before success still yields one proposal.
Files: src/outcome/ledger.ts, src/brain/evidence-proposals.ts, test/brain/evidence-proposals.test.ts
